description: dataRetrieval is an open-source software project listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Water", published or maintained by USGS-R (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). The list files it under "Water" (water resources). Language mentioned: R. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). It can support water resources studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
